title: Appamādo
text: -appamādo karaṇīyo ti || || (1-11) Antarapeyyālaṃ Tassuddānam || || Satthā Sikkhā ca Yogo ca || Chando Ussoḷhī pañcamī Appativānī Ātappaṃ || [page 133] XIII. 1. 4] ABHISAMAYA-SAṂYUTTA 133 Viriyaṃ Sātaccaṃ vuccati || Sati ca Sampajaññañca || Appamādena dvādasāti || || Suttantā antarapeyyālā niṭṭhitā || || Pare te dvādasa honti || suttā dvattiṃsasatāni || Catusaccena te vuttā || peyyāla-antaramhi ye || Antarapeyyāle hi uddānaṃ samattaṃ || || BOOK II ABHISAMAYA-SAṂYUTTA
